name: Aihara Miu
source:
A flat-chested, short girl.

She likes cosplaying as anime characters.

She's always with her stuffed animals.

She has a cheerful, bright personality and doesn't think about anything.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/soleil/itsudatsu/]official site[/url]]
